mgrn.review:
Asef Rafid For His 103, go with
Mgrn sir (section 17..)
Grading: I’m currently taking this course with this faculty, and so far, he grades fairly. In fact, his quizzes are mostly based on the slides. The midterm will include broad questions, but if you put in a little effort, you can easily score 15+ out of 20. He also takes presentations and viva.
Learning: He teaches through stories and real-life scenarios.. Overall, I’d rate the learning experience 8.5/10.
Above all, he is very easygoing and approachable.
